environment.description: Provider backend deployed on EKS with a public-facing AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) in TCP passthrough mode. The NLB forwards raw TCP to the pod on port 8443. No ingress controller is deployed. Service type is LoadBalancer with annotation service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: external. API keys are distributed to all team members via shared Vault path. Any HTTP client with a valid API key can reach the endpoint directly.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB in TCP passthrough mode
config.api_key_distribution: shared Vault KV path accessible to all engineers
